099b335c Do I need a broker to buy a yacht?
6df78ec6 It isn't compulsory, but a broker checks what the listing doesn't say: the history, the true condition, the tax position, and the boats that are never advertised.
023e4d61 By industry custom, the sales commission is paid by the seller. For the buyer, our guidance adds nothing to the price.
a7bd272b What costs come on top of the purchase price?
2ddfbae2 The independent survey, registration and flag, any duties or VAT depending on the boat's status, and recommissioning. We cost them all before the offer.
00ae4434 How much does a yacht cost to run each year?
19663ddd Around 10 % of her value, depending on size, age and use: crew, maintenance, insurance, berth and fuel. The calculator above gives you the order of magnitude.
9eed3956 Can I charter out my yacht to reduce costs?
22b68ae6 Yes. Around ten charter weeks a season often cover a large share of the running costs. We handle the charter management and the bookings.
c26b848c How long does it take to buy?
d04d03f1 Usually one to three months from the first viewing to the handover: time for the survey, the sea trial and the formalities.
cc8f3a2e Can I buy from abroad?
ada5d5a3 Yes. We arrange video viewings, the survey and the paperwork, and welcome you for the sea trial. We work in French, English, German and Italian.
